mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 2% signals weakening household demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods where RSAFS YoY < -2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 6.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 6.5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) exceeding 3% signals contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO YoY < -3% for 6 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) below 500k units signals weakening residential investment, which reduces GDP growth and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 500k for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 6.5% combined with a year-over-year decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 2% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 6.5% for 3 months AND PAYEMS YoY growth < -2%
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 6.5% for 3 months AND PAYEMS YoY < -2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 2% combined with a decline in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) below 500k units signals weakening household demand and residential investment, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS YoY growth < -2% AND HOUST < 500k for 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when RSAFS YoY < -2% AND HOUST < 500k for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).
